pooled_vs_relabelled.explanation: For multiplicity m_g, both encodings profile to the same weighted criterion and hence the same rural-coefficient argmin set. Because that set can be nonunique, the two LP encodings need not select the same realized coefficient without a common explicit tie rule; the observed SDs are nevertheless practically indistinguishable.

penalty_bound.terminology: Correct as the one-sided noninferiority bound for ruling out a penalty. Full symmetric equivalence additionally requires the upper-side test; here beta_hat < 0, so the lower-side bound is the binding TOST condition and the numerical margin is the same.
